_note: First TRELLIS asset set (docs/09 enemies, submarines, seabed decor). Static meshes: creatures move procedurally in Unity (Ambient* components). Seeds are fixed so a re-run reproduces the concept; change a seed to get a different design. "yaw" turns a moving model so its head leads (read from props.py's top-down render; Blender -> Unity is (x, y, z) -> (-x, z, -y)). Crystal clusters and cargo stacks are procedural (art/blender/environment.py): their dense surfaces need 28-45k voxels, beyond what TRELLIS's mesh decoder fits in 8 GB.
